create_batch_tensors: create a Batch dataclass instance with x and y torch tensors for sequence data
collate_batches: collate a list of Batch instances into one padded Batch using Batch.collate_fn
optimize_batch_tokens: optimize batch packing with BatchOptimizer to maximize tokens under a max_num_tokens limit
walk_code_files: walk a directory of Python or json.gz files with CodeWalker to yield DelayedReader instances randomly
augment_python_code: augment Python source code by reordering and removing top-level class and function definitions with PyAugmenter
